description: The install.sh MODULE-OWNERSHIP comment (~L1106) historically stated a module total of 35; the live non-README count is 41 (drifted before arc-71, several modules added without updating the prose count). Arc-71 ADA dropped the stale numeric total from the line it had to touch rather than fold a full recount (a drive-by). Plan: a one-line follow-up that re-derives the count from ls substrate/modules/*.md grep -v README wc -l and restores an accurate total -- or fold into the next substrate arc that touches that block. Pre-existing drift, not arc-71 scope. Anchor: arc-71 ADA build hand-back on stoa--7gl.
title: [FOLLOW-UP arc-71] install.sh MODULE-OWNERSHIP comment stale module count (said 35, actual 41 non-README)
